speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It was not in there when I looked. The bucket goes up. The horn was not part of the bucket.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: It was. I heard it knock. Twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An hour. I have turned the pack out, and Richard will not turn it out again.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Tip it. Don't tell it as a tale while you're tipping it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: There. I meant it to carry messages. A horn is a sort of message.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is my ink, and it is out, and that is the end of the story.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You were going to say it funnier in London.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not. We agreed it on Wednesday, on the floor. It works a little, and it had my ink, and neither of those is a play.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The essential piece is still off. Judith took it, and it goes better, and I don't thank her where she can hear.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then thank her in the kitchen, and let me have the horn. Supper is a pie, not a machine.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Put it in the pack yourself. Last time it walked off and became a bucket.
